# SOP-HGU-004 Hydrogen Generation Unit start-up procedure - Revision 3

SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE - NOT REAL DATA. Standard operating procedure. Status: approved.

## Steps

1. Confirm the permit to work is closed and the unit is handed back by maintenance.
2. Purge the reformer with nitrogen until oxygen is below the limit in the operating manual.
3. Light the reformer burners in the sequence given by the burner management system.
4. Start compressor C-501 only after lube oil pressure is normal.
